title: [FMLA 07] Resistance — Resistance of a Conductor
summary: Ohmic resistance from resistivity, length, and cross-section.

body.text: Calculator scroll name: Resistance. Ohmic resistance from resistivity, length, and cross-section.
Think of a corridor: a long thin corridor is harder to walk through than a short wide one. That is R = ρ ℓ / S.

body.caption: A wire of length ℓ and end-area S. Longer ℓ raises R; a fatter S lowers R. ρ is “how reluctant this metal is.”

body.text: Primary inputs: ρ, ℓ, S (length ℓ and cross-section S, not L and A).

body.title: How to run
items: Press FMLA, then 0, then 7 (or scroll to the name and EXE)

body.label: Units
body.text: SI: ρ in Ω·m, ℓ in m, cross-section S in m² (S, ℓ, ρ > 0). Result R is in ohms.
